imageryCaptureDate: unknown; do not describe as a current survey
method: Manually noted visible roof corners in the north-up preview, transformed by the original Web Mercator tile extent. These are roof planes, not cadastral ground footprints; overhang and image parallax may differ from walls.
usage: Numerical study data for approximate context massing. Original satellite imagery and tiles are not included. Authored museum models and OSM road clearances take precedence.
heights: All storey counts, wall heights and wall colours are estimates. Roof colours approximate appearance in this single image.
